[[Fire Orchid Seed]]s are planted in patches of [[Fertile Soil|fertile soil]] as part of [[The Wayfarer's Henge]] achievement chain. Can also be traded in to [[Supplymaster Hanjo]] for [[Fire Orchid Blossom]]s after completing [[A Henge Away from Home]] achievement.
